sources.title: ABPI Code of Practice for the Pharmaceutical Industry
MHRA Blue Guide — Advertising and Promotion of Medicines in the UK

medical.title: Claims consistent with SmPC
medical.check_prompt: Flag claims inconsistent with the supplied UK SmPC. Missing SmPC → [GAP].

medical.title: Misleading impression / exaggeration
medical.check_prompt: Flag exaggerated, all-embracing, or absolute claims (e.g. 'safe', 'no side effects') common to Code complaints when unsupported.

legal.title: Comparisons fair and substantiated
legal.check_prompt: Flag comparative claims without a clear basis in supplied evidence and without fair presentation of the comparator.

regulatory.title: Prescription-only advertising controls
regulatory.check_prompt: Confirm audience is HCPs and that copy is not directed to the public. Flag consumer-facing placement.

regulatory.title: Prescribing information / obligatory information
regulatory.check_prompt: For promotional items that require prescribing information under UK rules, flag absence or incompleteness. Format unknown → [GAP].

regulatory.title: PMCPA / company certification path
regulatory.check_prompt: Remind that final certification under the ABPI Code is a company process. This packet prepares humans; it does not certify.
